toml:
[attributes.payload]
value = "string"

[attributes.text-payload]
abstract = true
sub = "payload"

[entities.content]
abstract = true

[entities.page]
abstract = true
sub = "content"

[relations.interaction]
abstract = true

[relations.content-engagement]
abstract = true

[attributes.my-attr]
value = "string"
bindgen_case = "PascalCase"
annotations = ["internal"]

[entities.my-entity]
bindgen_case = "Python, SnakeCase"
annotations = ["dto_name(MyEntityDto)"]

[relations.my-relation]
bindgen_case = "CamelCase"
annotations = ["custom_annotation"]

typeql:
define
attribute isbn @abstract, value string;

define
attribute age, value integer @range(0..150);

define
attribute status, value string @regex("^(paid|dispatched)$");

define
attribute reaction, value string @values("like", "love", "funny");

define
relation bare_rel, relates participant;

toml:
[attributes.name]
value = "string"

[attributes.score]
value = "double"

[entities.person]
owns = ["name"]
plays = [{ relation = "review", role = "reviewer" }]

[entities.document]
owns = ["name"]
plays = [{ relation = "review", role = "document" }]

[relations.review]
roles = [
    { name = "document", card = "1..1" },
    { name = "reviewer", card = "1..3" },
]
owns = ["score"]

[attributes.title]
value = "string"

[relations.publication]
roles = [{ name = "publisher" }]
owns = ["title"]
plays = [
    { relation = "contribution", role = "work" },
    { relation = "review", role = "reviewed", card = "0..5" },
]

[relations.contribution]
roles = [{ name = "work" }]

[relations.review]
roles = [{ name = "reviewed" }]

[relations.contribution]
roles = [{ name = "contributor" }, { name = "work" }]

[relations.authoring]
sub = "contribution"
roles = [{ name = "author", as = "contributor" }]
